build_ranking_model: build a TorchRankerAgent subclass that implements score_candidates for ranking dialogue responses
review_score_candidates: review the abstract score_candidates method to understand how to rank candidates by score
build_candidates_from_batch: build a candidate set from batch labels using the batch source in _build_candidates
encode_candidate_vecs: encode and cache fixed candidate vectors for fast inference with --encode-candidate-vecs True
set_fixed_candidates: set fixed candidates from a file path using --fixed-candidates-path for all examples
